profile.label: Club
profile.value: Baseball, second base: a bunt-and-steal hitter

profile.label: Likes
profile.value: Baseball · Late-night radio · Convenience store snacks

profile.label: Habits
profile.value: Bounces a ball off the wall while thinking · Keeps a fixed pre-game routine

p1-0.monologue: Nothing to do. What should I start with.

p1-1.monologue: The room's a little dark. …No, it's always been like this, hasn't it.

p1-3.monologue: Going through them one by one keeps bringing that day back… Enough. Stop.

p1-5.monologue: Only a few left. …No. Forget it.

p1-7.monologue: I have seen all of it, and the room only got darker.

p2-0.monologue: …That was a real voice just now. The door side is bright.

p2-1.monologue: Let's start by getting ready to leave. Anything. Let's try.

p2-4.monologue: …Dad said it back then. That trip was strange.

p2-8.monologue: It was a lie. But it was for me. …Should I try?

p2-11.monologue: It looks different the second time. Time to go.

ball-intro.line1: That game that day. It was something else.
ball-intro.line2: Let's see if I've still got my swing.

frame-photo.line1: This is from the youth baseball tournament, the day I placed.

frame-photo-echo.line1: …My parents' faces. I can finally see them properly.
frame-photo-echo.line2: When I find them, I'll start with this photo.

console-intro.line1: Been a while. Time for a round.
console-intro.line2: Loser bought snacks. That was the rule.

console-echo.line1: When I get out, we're playing a round.

window-silence.line1: The first few days, the sirens went all night.
window-silence.line2: Now… there's no sound at all.

phone-stopped.line1: The last message is from October 19.
phone-stopped.line2: The group chat has never been this quiet.

computer-power-on.line1: There was a person on the radio. Then the news from that day must be saved somewhere too.
computer-power-on.line2: The internet's been dead since that day… but whatever's saved will do.
computer-power-on.line3: I press the power button on the dust-covered tower.

computer-archive.line1: Look at them, laughing away. I never did reply.
computer-archive.line2: And after that… the world was stopping, little by little.
computer-archive.line3: It wasn't just me. Everyone kept trying to reach each other, right to the end.

phone-unlock-intro.line3: …The fingerprint won't take. I changed the passcode… what was it?

phone-unlock-result.line1: She sent these that day. They only arrived now.
phone-unlock-result.line2: She told me to wait. …I have waited long enough.

calendar-intro.line1: The calendar stopped there too. October 19.

calendar-tally.line1: How many tally marks is that now…
calendar-tally.line2: I stopped counting. Counting makes it feel longer.

radio-intro.line1: The radio is the only thing left.
radio-intro.line2: …It only ever picks up noise anyway.

radio-broadcast.line1: …This is an emergency broadcast. A zombie outbreak is underway. All citizens must take shelter indoors immediately.
radio-broadcast.line2: The infection has spread past the capital region into the entire south.
radio-broadcast.line3: It has reached Busan. The areas still under control are…
radio-broadcast.line6: I hadn't forgotten. I was pretending I had.

radio-voice-intro.line1: …You went dead. I watched you go dead.

radio-voice.line1: Ah, damn… is this thing even transmitting? Can anyone hear me?
radio-voice.line2: If you're alive out there, come to us. Remember, the answer is here.
radio-voice.line3: We'll talk once we're together… kssht… click.
radio-voice.line4: That's a person. That's a real voice.
radio-voice.line5: Nothing happens if I keep sitting here.

ball-echo.line1: Maybe I can stop throwing it alone.
ball-echo.line2: When I find someone to catch it, we'll throw again.

fridge-open.line1: If I'm going out, I should take something. Start with the fridge.
fridge-open.line2: I've been eating for a month and it's still half full.
fridge-open.line3: Two nights, they said. So why stock this much?

duffel-pack.line1: I'll empty the baseball bag. The glove stays.
duffel-pack.line2: Water, cans, a flashlight. That should do it.
duffel-pack.line3: First time I've packed anything in thirty days.

shoes-open.line1: The shoe cabinet. Haven't opened it in a long time.
shoes-open.line3: No walking on this one. I'll leave the boots.
shoes-open.line4: A trip with no walking, and two suitcases.
shoes-open.line5: What exactly did you carry off with you?

cards-intro.line1: The cards are still laid out on the table.
cards-intro.line2: We'll finish this hand next time.

cards-unfinished.line2: Next time, they said. Did they mean it?
cards-unfinished.line3: No. They meant it. That's why nobody cleared the table.

ampoule-note.line1: The note on the fridge door. The magnet hid a second page.
ampoule-note.line2: Don't touch the bottom drawer. Your mother sorted it out.
ampoule-note.line3: The boots, the unfinished hand, and this note.
ampoule-note.line4: All of it wore the face of coming back. But sorting things out is what people do when they leave.

ampoule-found.line2: A glass ampoule. The label is half worn off. I can't read it.
ampoule-found.line3: They buried this under the food and left?
ampoule-found.line4: …They knew. They knew this was coming.
ampoule-found.line5: Then this isn't something they abandoned. It's something they left for me.

console.title: Not fun anymore
console.phase1: Alone, winning and losing feel the same.
console.phase2: Maybe it gets fun again with two.

window.title: Outside
window.phase1: I opened the curtain. Broken glass, a crushed car, stains that will not wash off. I closed it again.

frame.title: My Parents
frame.phase1: Dust on the glass hides their faces. Even wiped clean, only my parents stay blurred.
frame.phase2: I put the pieces back and the faces returned. We just haven't met yet.

fridge.title: What They Stocked
fridge.phase2: The fridge and the cupboard are still half full. Why was there a month of food in this house?

duffel.title: What to Take
duffel.phase2: I emptied my baseball bag and packed it again. Water and cans this time, not a glove.

computer.title: What Was Saved
computer.phase2: Dad's trip emails I never answered, and the news left in the cache. The world stopped little by little, then all at once.

radio.title: That Broadcast
radio.phase1: They said it had reached Busan. I cannot pretend not to know anymore.
radio.phase2: A human voice came through the noise. "Hey, is anyone there?" I am not the only one.

phone.title: The Silence
phone.phase1: The group chat has been quiet since that day. Every missed call is one I made.
phone.phase2: Mom's texts from that day finally arrived. Lock the door and wait, she said. …I have waited enough.

calendar.title: October 19
calendar.phase1: The numbers stopped on that day. After that I stopped writing dates and only made tally marks.

ball.title: Catch, Alone
ball.phase1: Throw it at the wall and it comes back. That is all. I keep forgetting there is no one to catch it.
ball.phase2: If someone out there can catch it, this ball still has a use.

shoes.title: The Boots They Left
shoes.phase2: The hiking boots are still in the cabinet. A trip with no walking, they said. So why was there so much luggage?

cards.title: The Unfinished Hand
cards.phase2: The cards are still on the table. We'll finish it next time, they said. The hand never moved.

ampoule.title: An Unmarked Ampoule
ampoule.phase2: The label is half worn away, unreadable. I am holding a question, not an answer.

cut1.line1: "Back soon," they said, and left. Like always.
cut1.line2: If I'd known that was the last of it, I'd have said something more.
cut1.line3: …No. They knew. That's exactly why they said nothing.
cut1.line4: They didn't leave me behind. They were keeping me.

cut1.line1: Three years with this bat. All I ever hit with it was a ball.
